visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man, Peter, sits outdoors on a rooftop balcony in Paris. He has black hair and wears a black leather jacket. He smiles at the camera, holding a white box with the CHANEL logo. The background features Parisian rooftops under a grey, cloudy sky. (2) Peter opens the white box to reveal a minimalist invitation card. He uses his hands, which have colorful nail polish, to show the card to the lens. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the texture of the box and his facial expressions. (3) Peter pulls out a small black velvet pouch and retrieves a silver necklace with a tiny house-shaped pendant. He holds the necklace up, allowing the metal to glint in the daylight. The camera zooms in slightly to capture the details of the pendant. (4) Peter demonstrates a unique feature of the pendant by looking through a small lens on the back of the tiny house. He holds it close to his eye while gesturing with his other hand to explain its function. The background remains the same urban terrace. (5) Graphic overlays appear on the screen showing two teaser images from CHANEL’s social media, including a black-and-white portrait and a feather earring. Peter points to these while looking back and forth between the camera and the graphics. (6) Peter puts the necklace around his neck. He laughs and continues talking, adjusting his jacket. The wind blows his hair slightly as the scene concludes with him smiling warmly at the camera.
